title: Walking down to a school, a class or a person

handbook.what: A drawn tree of everything hanging beneath the level you are on — groups inside groups, the classes in each, the teachers who take them and the staff who teach nothing yet. It is one picture of the shape of your organisation, not a list you have to filter.
handbook.where: The **Below this** panel under the numbers on any group or school page.
how: Open a group or a school.
Tap a caret to open or close what sits under a name.
Tap any name to go to that level — the numbers and the tree redraw for it.
A class row names its teachers and its student count without you opening it.
Where there are more than eight classes or people, a **more** button reveals the rest.
handbook.note: The top two levels open themselves and deeper ones wait to be tapped, so a large organisation shows you its shape instead of eighty-five rows.
